title: 第1551章 捏死叛徒黄云第1550章 抓捕中生波折
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
苗诗烟咬牙重新撑起一道薄薄的光盾，硬生生挡下那一刀。
她闷哼一声，嘴角鲜血更多，却死战不退。
秦峰抓住黄云，侧身避开柳立晨的后续追击。
他突然听到远方有更多的脚步声向这边传来，搞不好有上百人。
地面微微震颤，树林深处影影绰绰，显然祈灵神朝的大批援军到了。
他对着不远处围杀苗诗烟的方向看了一眼，然后一剑斩了过去。
那道剑光斜掠而出，如同弯月坠地，直接将其中一人斩的尸首分离，同时也多出一个缺口。
秦峰道：“他们又有人来了，先撤！”
说着二人迅速的向来时的方向撤退而去，脚下灵光闪烁，疾奔如风。
柳立晨道：“追，不能让他们跑了。”
他率先提刀追出，身后仅剩的七八名修士也慌忙跟上。
而此刻后面又多了一支队伍，其实这里已经算是祈灵神朝的地盘了。
要不然也不会又来一波支援，像捅了马蜂窝一样。
新来的援军中甚至有两位半步天神境的头目，杀气腾腾地包抄过来。
秦峰回头看了一眼，心中暗忖，若被合围，今日必死无疑。
他体内灵力疯狂运转，将雷遁之术催到极致，脚尖点地如飞燕掠水。
苗诗烟虽然受伤，但咬着牙紧随其后，双手不断向后甩出小型光盾阻敌。
那些追兵被光盾一挡，速度稍减，却依旧咬得很紧。
要不是秦峰跑得快，被敌方包围了，那对方来的人会越来越多，到时候就麻烦了。
他带着苗诗烟在山林间左突右冲，专挑陡峭险峻的小径穿行。

祈灵修士们不熟悉地形，被几棵巨木和山石阻隔，追势稍微放缓。
秦峰跟苗诗烟连跃三道溪涧，终于远远望见了镇邪关的城墙。
很快，二人便跑到了城下，秦峰道：“打开城门。”
他声音洪亮，带着不容置疑的威严，直冲城楼之上。
今天在上面守卫的正好是校尉吴大奎，他看到秦峰等人后面黑压压的一片。
那黑压压的追兵足有七八十人，战旗招展，杀声震天。
吓得腿都哆嗦了：“抱歉，秦大人，你后面追兵太多。你还是先把他们甩开再回来。”
他声音发颤，却透着一股幸灾乐祸的阴险，手指紧紧扣住城垛。
苗诗烟道：“你这是要害我们的命！”
她气急攻心，又咳出一口血，眼中满是愤怒。
秦峰冷声道：“吴校尉，你确定不开门？”
他的目光如冰锥刺向城头，周身散发出一股凌厉的杀气。
吴大奎道：“抱歉，为了城中修士的安全。不能打开城门。”
他内心狂笑，秦峰啊秦峰，你也有求我的一天。
此刻他心里十分的爽利，终于可以拿捏秦峰了，之前的阴霾一扫而空。
之前秦峰驳他面子，今日总算逮着机会报这一箭之仇。
他甚至还下令城头弓弩手拉满弦，对准城下，做出一副防备姿态。
苗诗烟有些紧张道：“他们快过来了，我们怎么办？”
content_en:
Miao Shiyan gritted her teeth and used a thin light shield to block the knife.
She groaned, and there was more blood at the corner of her mouth, but she refused to retreat.
Qin Feng grabbed Huang Yun and sidestepped to avoid Liu Lichen's follow-up pursuit.
He suddenly heard more footsteps approaching in the distance, maybe hundreds of people.
The ground trembled slightly, and there were shadows in the depths of the woods. It was obvious that a large number of reinforcements from the Prayer God Dynasty had arrived.
He glanced in the direction where Miao Shiyan was being surrounded and killed not far away, and then struck with his sword.
The sword light swept out diagonally, like a crescent moon falling to the ground, directly separating the corpse of one of them, leaving an additional gap at the same time.
Qin Feng said: "They are here again, retreat first!"
As they spoke, the two of them quickly retreated in the direction they came from, their feet flashing with light and running as fast as the wind.
Liu Lichen said: "Chase, we can't let them escape."
He took the lead and chased out with his sword, and the remaining seven or eight monks behind him also hurriedly followed.
At this moment, there is another team behind, and this is actually the territory of the Qingling Divine Dynasty.
Otherwise, there won't be another wave of support, and it will be like poking a hornet's nest.
Among the new reinforcements, there were even two leaders who were half-step into the realm of gods, and they surrounded them with murderous intent.
Qin Feng looked back and thought to himself that if he was surrounded, he would definitely die today.
The spiritual power in his body was running wildly, pushing the lightning escape technique to the extreme, and his toes touched the ground like a flying swallow gliding over the water.
Although Miao Shiyan was injured, she gritted her teeth and followed closely, her hands constantly throwing back small light shields to block the enemy.
The pursuers were blocked by the light shield and their speed slowed down slightly, but they still held tight.
If Qin Feng hadn't run fast and was surrounded by the enemy, more and more people would have come, and it would have been troublesome.
He led Miao Shiyan through the mountains and forests, choosing steep and dangerous paths.
The praying monks were unfamiliar with the terrain and were blocked by several giant trees and rocks, so their pursuit slowed down slightly.
Qin Feng and Miao Shiyan jumped three streams in a row, and finally saw the city wall of Zhenxie Pass from a distance.
Soon, the two of them ran to the bottom of the city. Qin Feng said: "Open the city gate."
With a loud voice and unquestionable majesty, he rushed straight to the tower.
The person guarding the place today happened to be Captain Wu Dakui. He saw the darkness behind Qin Feng and others.
There were seventy or eighty people in the black and heavy pursuit, with battle flags fluttering and the sound of killing loud.
His legs were shaking with fear: "I'm sorry, Mr. Qin, there are too many soldiers chasing you. You'd better get rid of them first and then come back."
His voice was trembling, but there was a sinister sense of schadenfreude, and his fingers were tightly clasped on the battlements.
Miao Shiyan said: "You are trying to kill us!"
She was so angry that she coughed out another mouthful of blood, her eyes filled with anger.
Qin Feng said coldly: "Colonel Wu, are you sure you don't want to open the door?"
His gaze was like an ice pick piercing the city, and his whole body exuded a fierce murderous aura.
Wu Dakui said: "Sorry, for the safety of the monks in the city, we cannot open the city gate."
He laughed wildly in his heart, Qin Feng, Qin Feng, you too will beg me one day.
At this moment, he felt very happy. He could finally take control of Qin Feng, and the previous haze was gone.
Qin Feng had refuted his face before, but today he finally took the opportunity to take revenge.
He even ordered the crossbowmen at the top of the city to fully draw their strings and aim at the city, making a defensive posture.
Miao Shiyan said nervously: "They are coming soon, what should we do?"
